definitions.explanation: The most important central element of an organization, plan, or group. The driving force or essential component.

examples.japanese: チームの{中核|ちゅうかく}を{担|にな}う。
examples.english: To serve as the core of the team.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{組織|そしき}の{中核|ちゅうかく}メンバーだ。
examples.english: He is a core member of the organization.

examples.japanese: この{技術|ぎじゅつ}が{事業|じぎょう}の{中核|ちゅうかく}となり、{会社|かいしゃ}の{成長|せいちょう}を{支|ささ}えている。
examples.english: This technology serves as the core of the business and supports the company's growth.

notes:
FORMS:
{中|ちゅう} (center) + {核|かく} (nucleus, core)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中核|ちゅうかく}: core, nucleus (organizational/strategic)
- {中枢|ちゅうすう}: center, nerve center (control/command)
- {核心|かくしん}: crux, heart of the matter (of an issue or problem)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中核|ちゅうかく}を{担|にな}う: to serve as the core
- {中核|ちゅうかく}{事業|じぎょう}: core business
- {中核|ちゅうかく}メンバー: core member
- {中核|ちゅうかく}{都市|とし}: core city
